closures.control: Canonical HMAC of all nested retained records, exact-object index verification, and deep-copy egress
Terminal exact-object proof executes inside the retained final journal writer before applied append
Authenticated v2 independent full-row outbox witness rejects older database replay and missing enrollment
Cursor/anchor preflight and durable claim witness both precede downstream publication
Locked bounded receipt-consumption registry shared by authority/host/install/boot trust domain

residuals: Private Python memory and its key are not isolated from arbitrary same-process code.
NTFS namespace topology and a JSONL journal append are not one atomic kernel transaction; exact object custody and proof cover the retained writer boundary.
Crash between separate outbox and witness commits fails closed; coordinated rollback of both needs an external monotonic witness.
Driver receipt consumption is shared across in-process instances, not persisted across process or reboot boundaries.
